verdict.rationale: A probe confirms that Increase documents an official CLI in its own GitHub organization (Increase/increase-cli), which directly meets the story's core requirement. The evidence is limited to that single mention, with no detail on what the CLI does. Missing for 10: documentation of CLI commands and coverage (e.g. transfers, accounts, sandbox simulations), install/auth details, AI-agent-oriented usage guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
